purpose.zh: 练大腿内侧和臀腿，提升侧向下蹲能力
purpose.en: Build the inner thighs and legs and improve your side-to-side squat.

text.zh: 蹲向一侧，另一腿伸直脚尖朝上
text.en: Squat to one side and keep the other leg straight with toes up

text.zh: 蹲的一侧脚跟踩实，膝盖对准脚尖
text.en: Keep the squatting heel down and the knee over the toes.

text.zh: 胸口挺起，双臂向前平伸保持平衡
text.en: Keep your chest up and reach your arms forward for balance.

commonErrors.en: Bending the knee of the straight leg.
Lifting the heel on the squatting side.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不适时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squat less deep if your knees feel uncomfortable, and stop if the pain continues.
